purpose: Research model for the Farmer and Dog roles in the Farm/Sektur/Swamp framework. This separates observable communication patterns from speculative psychology and uses biblical material as symbolic/theological cross-reference rather than as a claim that particular people are literally biblical figures.
epistemic_rule: Do not diagnose anonymous posters or public creators from forum posts. Do not infer psychopathy, narcissism, delusion, cult membership or mental illness from tone alone. Record observable behavior first, then possible mechanisms as hypotheses, and distinguish community self-presentation from private motives.

core_model.farmer: The person or group that cultivates, documents, interprets, frames, archives, comments on, monetizes or otherwise harvests recurring attention around a Cow.
core_model.dog: The pursuit/amplification/enforcement function: watches, alerts, chases, reacts, guards territory, attacks perceived intruders, repeats signals and helps keep attention moving. A Dog can be a person, account, clique, moderator, commentator or symbolic role.
core_model.cow: The recurring subject whose public output, reactions or conflicts provide the material being harvested.
core_model.farm: The social and media ecology connecting Cows, Farmers, Dogs, audiences, archives, platforms and incentives.
core_model.swamp: The wider environment of money, status, algorithms, identity, ideology, institutional incentives, grievance, reputation and information asymmetry in which the Farm operates.

psychological_mechanisms_to_test_not_ass: variable reward from unpredictable Cow reactions
farmer_research.known_online_mechanism_evidence: Experimental and observational research indicates anonymity and dispersed collectivity can reduce self-consciousness and diffuse responsibility in trolling contexts. Anonymity has also been experimentally associated with increased trolling; this supports studying environment and group structure rather than assuming a fixed 'troll personality'.
weaknesses_or_failure_modes: becoming dependent on a Cow for identity or entertainment
confusing public information with unlimited moral permission
becoming the story while insisting on being only the observer

inversions.name: Farmer becomes Cow
inversions.description: A commentator becomes sufficiently controversial, visible or repetitive that other communities begin archiving and milking the commentator.

inversions.name: Critic becomes Producer
inversions.description: The person claiming to merely document a Cow starts creating new narratives, thumbnails, clips, titles, compilations and recurring shows that generate additional attention.

inversions.name: Protector becomes Enforcer
inversions.description: Community-defense language shifts from warning and documentation into surveillance, punishment, harassment or exclusion.

inversions.name: Anti-cult becomes cultic
inversions.description: A community organized around exposing manipulation develops rigid orthodoxy, loyalty tests, taboo subjects, charismatic insiders and punishment for dissent.

inversions.name: Anti-delusion becomes shared mythology
inversions.description: Repeated discussion creates its own lore, terminology, heroes, villains and canon even while members claim to be merely documenting reality.

farmer_research.cult_pattern_checklist: Use this only as a structural comparison, never as a diagnosis: charismatic authority; insider/outsider boundary; sacred vocabulary; purity tests; heresy accusations; confession rituals; punishment for dissent; information control; repetitive slogans; escalating commitment; collective enemy construction; identity fusion; claims of special knowledge; moral absolutism; inability to tolerate correction.
farmer_research.darvo: DARVO means deny, attack, reverse victim and offender. It is a documented interpersonal response pattern, not a universal explanation for disagreement. Research shows DARVO can change observers' perceptions by making alleged perpetrators appear less responsible and victims less credible. Therefore the dataset should record concrete sequences—denial, attack, reversal—rather than simply tagging someone 'DARVO'.
farmer_research.research_question: When a Farmer claims to be outside the Farm, what observable investments show that they are actually inside it?

dog_research.definition: Dog is the pursuit, alarm, enforcement and amplification function inside the Farm model. The term is deliberately broader than 'harasser': a Dog can warn, guard, chase, attack, signal, repeat and mobilize attention. It can perform legitimate moderation or abusive enforcement depending on context.

face_value_masks.test: Does behavior stay proportional to a real threat?

face_value_masks.presentation: I am defending someone I support.
face_value_masks.test: Can the Dog criticize its own side without losing status?

face_value_masks.presentation: I am only responding to trolls.
face_value_masks.test: Does response perpetuate the same attention loop?

face_value_masks.presentation: I am simply passing along what I found.

Who authorized the consequence and what limits exist?

dog_weaknesses: being manipulated by whoever produces the strongest trigger

dog_inversions.name: Guard becomes attacker
dog_inversions.description: Protective monitoring turns into unsolicited pursuit or aggression.

dog_inversions.name: Watchdog becomes surveillance system
dog_inversions.description: Observation becomes continuous tracking unrelated to a proportionate safety purpose.

dog_inversions.name: Anti-troll becomes troll
dog_inversions.description: Attempts to fight provocation reproduce the same provocative behavior and attention loop.

dog_inversions.name: Enforcer becomes Cow
dog_inversions.description: The Dog's own repeated enforcement creates enough spectacle to make the Dog the new subject.

dog_research.cult_pattern: The Dog role is especially vulnerable to pack identity. A group can transform ordinary disagreement into a loyalty test: defend the in-group, attack the out-group, repeat the shared vocabulary, and treat dissent as betrayal. This is a structural analogy to cult-like dynamics, not a claim that every Farm community is a cult.
dog_research.darvo_and_dogs: A Dog may encounter DARVO from a Cow, Farmer or another Dog. The correct research method is to preserve the sequence and evidence: original allegation -> response -> denial/minimization -> attack -> reversal -> audience reaction. Do not assume the first speaker is truthful merely because the response looks like DARVO.
dog_research.spiritual_function: Within the project's symbolic theology, Dog represents the force that watches the boundary of the Farm. The healthy form is discernment and protection; the corrupted form is persecution, false accusation and compulsive pursuit.
dog_research.research_question: When does protection stop protecting anything and become a self-sustaining hunt?

biblical_crosswalk_for_dog.note: Biblical references use the Bible's own symbolic language. They should not be mapped one-to-one onto modern forum users.

references.crosswalk: Jesus uses 'dogs' in a warning about what is sacred and how indiscriminate exposure can lead to trampling and attack. Symbolically useful for the Dog as boundary-keeper, while also warning against careless engagement.

Paul warns the community about 'dogs' and evil workers. Symbolically this supports the Dog as a warning/enforcement figure, but the text itself is not a license to label contemporary opponents as dogs.
Dogs appear among those excluded from the final holy city. Symbolically this can represent boundary, exclusion and the moral danger of falsehood; it should not be used to dehumanize real people.
The text describes blind watchmen and greedy dogs that cannot bark. This is particularly relevant to the Dog role: a watchdog can fail by being silent, blind, greedy or self-interested.
Dogs appear as part of an image of hostile forces surrounding the sufferer. Symbolically useful for the Dog as a surrounding pressure or pack, not as a literal identification.
The dog proverb is used to depict returning to a previous condition. In the Farm model this can represent repetitive cycles: conflict -> apparent exit -> return -> renewed attention.

biblical_crosswalk_for_dog.central_theological_duality: The biblical Dog is not simply 'evil dog'. The stronger symbolic use for this project is boundary function: watch, warn, guard, exclude, pursue, return. The same function can protect a boundary or become corrupted into appetite, false accusation and pack aggression.

basic_loop: Cow reacts or produces new material
farmer_dog_interaction.key_inversion: The most important inversion is that the Farm can eventually become independent of the original Cow. The Cow is no longer the only producer. Farmers and Dogs begin producing the narrative, reactions, memes, archives and conflicts themselves.
farmer_dog_interaction.ethical_rule: The repository should study the mechanism without reproducing it unnecessarily. Documentation should increase understanding rather than become another Farm designed to manufacture humiliation or harassment.
